answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 12676 Country: Canada Title: What is the Sunnah method of holding a miswak? Question: What is the Sunnah method of holding a miswak? Answer ID: 12676 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 847/815=B/1430) The sunnah way to hold miswak is that the little finger of right hand should be placed under the miswak, the thumb over the head of it, while the other fingers over it: والسنۃ في أخذہ أن تجعل خنصر یمینک أسفلہ والبنصر والسبابۃ فوقہ والإبھام أسفل رأسہ، کما رواہ ابن مسعود ( الشامی 1:334، کتاب الطھارۃ ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
